inputs.DINO_excluded: DINO cached features are pooled 4x4, not the native 16x16 patch representation used for this native-192-D report; they are not commensurate with the native target layout.

interpretation_limits: This is a true-target representation-geometry ordering diagnostic: each anchor and every alternative are real trajectories from one source scene.
It does not measure model-predicted physical error; cached model predictions were not read.
It does not establish that a predictor learned or failed to learn dynamics, and it does not measure goal cost or planning quality.
Selected physical coordinates are not complete states; visibility, rendering, and selected-coordinate omissions can contribute to disagreement, so reversals are not attributed solely to the encoder.
A good true-target distance ordering is not sufficient to validate off-manifold predicted latent physical error.
No scientific acceptance threshold is introduced; ordering tolerances only handle numerical ties.

protocol.alternatives: All other real condition-candidate trajectories from the same source scene; exclude identity.
protocol.dino_excluded: Cached 4x4 pooled patch features are not the native 16x16 patch space used by the benchmark score.
protocol.distance: Mean over five times of squared Euclidean error; selected physical coordinates or full native target latent. No goal costs.
protocol.large_error_contrast: Physical RMS errors differ by at least factor two and larger RMS is >=1 task unit (px-equivalent or mm); diagnostic effect-size subset, not accuracy acceptance.
limits: This does not use model predictions or test history utilization.
True-target ordering consistency is not sufficient to validate off-manifold predicted latent physical error.
Rendering/visibility and selected physical coordinates can cause discrepancies; do not attribute all reversals to the encoder.
No fixed acceptance threshold or new benchmark score is introduced.
protocol.ordering_tolerance: 1e-8 + 1e-7 * max(abs(distance_a), abs(distance_b)), separately in each distance space; numerical tolerance only.

physical_scope.mass: Fingertip xy in millimetres, not all joint states.
physical_scope.pusht: Agent xy, block xy, 40*sin(theta), 40*cos(theta), pixels-equivalent. Selected pose geometry, not full state.

protocol.primary_reversal_rate: reversed comparisons / comparisons with neither physical nor latent numerical ties; aggregate within scene, then average scenes.
protocol.purpose: Check whether distances between encoded real future trajectories preserve ordering of errors in selected task geometry.
protocol.reference: Each real condition-candidate future trajectory in turn.
protocol.supplementary_alternatives: Other actions under the same hidden condition.
protocol.tie_reporting: Report physical tie counts and latent tie fraction among physical-strict comparisons; do not interpret all-tie as perfect ordering.
protocol.uncertainty: 4000 source-cluster bootstrap samples, seed 20261008; mirrored Damping scenes together.

purpose: Calibrate ranking of true native latent trajectory distances against selected physical trajectory geometry.
